name: rules-rtdb-r15-validate-ancestor-scope
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r15-validate-ancestor-scope" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). isolates the scope of .validate: a rule on an ancestor of the written path is evaluated against the merged post-write value at that ancestor (production denies), while the same write under a rule-free ancestor is allowed; the simulator now reproduces that root-to-write validation walk.
